Name: Won Tickets Wallet Currency
Author: auryum2
Description:
This is a tiny mod for Return to Mineral Town that turns Won Tickets into a Wallet Currency, meaning you'll carry them around wherever you go without them taking up precious inventory space. Picked up Coins will automatically be stored in a shared between all players wallet.

You can check how many Won Tickets you currently have in the Special Items & Powers Tab, or when approaching a market stall in the hamlet.
Vapius Coins will be deducted from the wallet when making purchases.

Referenced Vapius Coin Wallet Current and other similar mods to create
